Subject: Executive demo & integration review — scheduling + security kickoff

Hi Tom / Helen —

Thanks again for taking the time to explore Redwood Inference with us. Per our conversation on Friday, we want to run a combined exec-facing demo (VP/CTO level) plus a short technical integration review so your engineering and security teams have actionable next steps. Goal: show a live demo tailored to MegaBank, confirm integration approach, and surface any procurement/security blockers before the QBR cadence.

Proposed high-level agenda (45-60m):
- 10m: Exec overview (value + business metrics) — VP-level
- 25m: Live integration demo (SE + customer engineer breakout for technical details)
- 10-15m: Security & procurement Q&A / next steps

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Mar 23 | 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Mar 24 | 08:00–09:00 PT (earlier for east coast execs)
- Thu Mar 25 | 13:00–14:00 PT

Please flag which of the above works for Tom and your CTO; if none, propose two alternatives and we will prioritize. Also: can you confirm attendees from engineering and procurement so we can add a 20-minute pre-demo security sync if required?

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf, integration-checklist.xlsx (stubs attached). I’ll send calendar invites once we lock a slot. HubSpot and a shared Drive folder are listed below for pre-read material.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Quick technical note from the SE side —

If we do Wed Mar 24 08:00 PT: recommend we split the session into two parts on the calendar: 20–25 minutes exec/demo (shared), then a 25–30 minute technical breakout with your engineers + our SEs. That lets us surface any network/credentials questions without taking up exec time.

Pre-reqs I want us to confirm ahead of the call:
- Access pattern (API vs VPC/private deployment) — please indicate which environment you prefer on the checklist
- Sample payload sizes and expected peak concurrency (we’ll use these to size the demo)
- Whether any PII/sample data will be used in the demo (if so we’ll anonymize and use synthetic datasets)

I’ve attached env-requirements.md with a short checklist for your engineers. Happy to run a 20-minute pre-demo tech sync the week prior if that helps.
